title: AgeCheck NotStarted/Started is a two-variant started flag beside AgeVerification params
trigger: user opens the age bot link (start_age_check) then the server re-sends the same params
effect: none today: Started survives only while params are equal, and any params change silently resets it by hand in set_age_verification
fix: fold into the verification stage: Needed{params} / BotOpened{params}, reset by its own transition

title: story_search_send_failed overwrites a Loading page with Failed without checking the request
trigger: search page A is in flight (PageFetch::Loading{A}); a second page send fails locally and calls story_search_send_failed
effect: stage becomes Failed while A is still out; A's answer is then dropped by search_waiting_for (page no longer waits for A), so the page that arrived is lost and Retry re-asks it
fix: fail only when page is Idle (the send that failed), or hold the request in the failure
